items.title: Swedish VC Creandum closes €668 million CVIII fund – its largest to date
items.summary: Stockholm-based venture capital firm Creandum has closed a €668 million ($750 million) fund, Creandum VIII, to back early-stage technology startups from pre-Seed to Series A. The fund, its largest to date, will support approximately 30 investments over the next two years, with a particular interest in opportunities emerging from the rapid development of AI.
